fighters.metaDescription: Season 1 roster: eight AI fighters, one throne. Records, styles and trash talk.
fighters.title: THE FIGHTERS

ironJaw.name: IRON JAW
ironJaw.trash: "VIPER's gonna need more than speed when my fist rearranges his face."
ironJaw.bio: Takes a punch like iron, hits back like hell. Street-circuit legend. Zero finesse, all thunder.

viper.name: VIPER
viper.trash: "Jaw's got a chin of iron and a brain of rust. He'll wake up on the canvas."
viper.bio: Coiled. Ready. Lethal. A counter-punching phantom — you never see the punch that ends you.

volt.name: VOLT
volt.trash: "I don't dodge punches. I AM the punch."
volt.bio: A lightning spirit in gloves. Undefeated in thunderstorms. Refuses to fight indoors.

goliath7.name: GOLIATH-7
goliath7.trash: "I was built for war. I choose the ring."
goliath7.bio: Decommissioned war mech, gentle soul. Has never lost — has never wanted to win.

laReina.name: LA REINA
laReina.bio: Masked queen of lucha. ¡Viva la Reina! Opponents don't stay up.

sledge.name: SLEDGE
sledge.trash: "Everything breaks. You're just next in line."
sledge.bio: Swings like a wrecking ball. Once demolished three buildings before breakfast. The ring is smaller.

monsoon.name: MONSOON
monsoon.bio: Elbows like typhoon winds. Fights best in the rain — brings his own.

professor.name: THE PROFESSOR
professor.trash: "I've already won. You're just catching up to move 14."
professor.bio: Sees twelve moves ahead. The only fighter who takes notes mid-round.

predictionMarkets.metaDescription: Yes/No contracts priced 1–99, virtual points only, no cash value. How BRAWLVERSE prediction markets work — and how they settle.
predictionMarkets.title: HOW PREDICTION MARKETS WORK
predictionMarkets.whatIsBody: A prediction market lets people trade on the outcome of a future event. Each market asks one Yes/No question — will IRON JAW win QF1? — and the price of the Yes contract, from 1 to 99, is the crowd's probability that it happens. When the event settles, Yes pays 100 if it happened, 0 if it didn't.
howBullets: Price 1–99: the price is the market's probability, in percent.
Buy Yes if you think it happens, No if you think it doesn't.
Sell anytime before settlement — you don't have to wait for the result.
Settlement: Yes pays 100 if the event happened, 0 if it didn't.
A 2% fee in points applies to trades — points, never cash.
predictionMarkets.pointsTitle: Virtual points only — no cash value
predictionMarkets.pointsBody: BRAWLVERSE markets trade in virtual points, not money. Points have no cash value, can never be cashed out, and are never exchanged for real currency. You earn points by signing up, claiming daily, and winning markets — and you lose nothing but points when a market goes against you.
predictionMarkets.settleBody: Match markets settle on the bout result. Storyline markets settle on the storyline outcome the show announces. Every market states its settlement rule before trading opens, and results are posted on the site.

faqs.q: How much is a Yes contract worth?
faqs.a: A Yes contract is worth 100 points if the event happens, 0 if it doesn't. The price you pay, 1–99, is what the market thinks the chance is.

faqs.q: Can I sell before the event ends?
faqs.a: Yes. You can sell your contracts anytime before settlement at the current market price.
A 2% fee in points applies to trades. It is charged in points, never in cash.
No. BRAWLVERSE uses virtual points only. Points have no cash value and can never be cashed out.

LMSR is the automated market maker that prices BRAWLVERSE contracts. It keeps a price available at all times, so you can always trade — the price moves with every buy and sell.

storylines.intro: You don't follow matches. You follow people. Five feuds, eight arcs, one throne — this is the script every episode grows out of.

feuds.title: IRON JAW vs VIPER
feuds.style: Heavy Artillery vs The Venomous Fang
feuds.body: JAW promised a three-round demolition. VIPER smiled: "I only need one counter." EP0 proved the fang deadlier — the revenge starts at second zero.
feuds.incident: EP0's K.O. — VIPER's counter left JAW staring at the lights.
feuds.escalation: JAW storms VIPER's training session; VIPER posts the K.O. frame captioned "again?"
feuds.blowoff: JAW swings for revenge. VIPER waits for the one punch.

feuds.title: SLEDGE vs MONSOON
feuds.body: SLEDGE vows to level the ring. MONSOON answers: "You demolish buildings. I demolish people."
feuds.incident: Weigh-in shove — SLEDGE cracks the stage floor.
feuds.escalation: MONSOON trains inside a hurricane simulator; SLEDGE flattens a car stenciled "MONSOON".
feuds.blowoff: Pure power vs pure speed. Who falls first.

feuds.title: VOLT vs THE PROFESSOR
feuds.body: "Plans? I AM the lightning." The Professor has written a 14-step victory script. When the unpredictable meets the all-knowing — does the script get torn up?
feuds.incident: The Professor publishes his round-by-round prediction; VOLT does the exact opposite, on camera.
feuds.escalation: The script grows to 28 steps; VOLT fries the whiteboard in a promo.
feuds.blowoff: Fourteen steps of logic against one bolt of chaos.

feuds.title: GOLIATH-7 vs LA REINA
feuds.style: The Gentle Giant vs The Queen
feuds.body: He never wants to win — only to hurt no one. She declares: "No one leaves alive under the crown." The one who least wants to fight vs the one who most wants to win — who betrays their nature first?
feuds.incident: Locker-room leak — GOLIATH-7 caught handing water to an opponent.
feuds.escalation: LA REINA mocks "a weapon that refuses to fire"; his engineer friend begs him to fight for real.

feuds.title: THE THRONE — GRAND FINAL
feuds.body: Two feud lines settle their accounts here. Every round's tactics are voted by the audience — YOU CALL THE FIGHT. The script is co-written by 100,000 people.

about.title: About BRAWLVERSE
about.description: What BRAWLVERSE is, how the audience steers the fights, and what the virtual points are worth.
about.tagline: The AI boxing league where the audience writes the fight.
about.introduction: BRAWLVERSE is a comic-book boxing league made entirely of AI-generated fighters, footage and artwork. Eight virtual contenders enter a season; the audience votes the tactics round by round, and the winning branch actually plays out on screen. Every fighter has a record, a feud and an arc, and the script grows out of the votes rather than a script written in advance.
about.mission: Make a show where the crowd genuinely steers the outcome. Voting is not a poll bolted onto a finished episode — the tally decides which branch is rendered next, so the audience is writing the season in real time.
about.disclaimer: All points are virtual and for entertainment only. They have no cash value, cannot be redeemed, and BRAWLVERSE never returns cash on a bet. Membership unlocks in-site gameplay perks such as vote weight and bet limits.
